youtube.title: 🔥 This AI Skill Builds Landing Pages Like Apple
youtube.description: Still building landing pages with static images and basic parallax? You're missing the scroll experience that makes people actually stop and engage. scroll-world is an agent skill for Claude Code and Codex that generates continuous camera flights through custom 3D scenes — the kind of immersive scroll-scrubbed experience you see on Apple product pages, but for any brand or industry you want. Just tell your AI agent what to showcase, and it builds a seamless flight where the camera dives from outside each scene into its interior with zero cuts. Your scroll position drives the entire journey. It's already got 1,518 stars because it uses Higgsfield AI to generate cohesive isometric scenes and frame-perfect connector clips between them. The skill handles the interview, asset generation, and wiring up a portable vanilla JS scrub engine that drops into any stack. Search scroll-world on GitHub to upgrade your landing pages from forgettable to unforgettable.

linkedin.text:
🚨 Your landing page may look polished — but if it feels static, visitors keep scrolling.

Creating an Apple-style 3D journey usually means custom WebGL, motion design, connector clips, and a lot of debugging. That is exactly the problem scroll-world solves. 🛠️

Tell Claude Code or Codex what brand or industry you want to showcase, and the repo builds a continuous camera flight through cohesive 3D scenes. Your visitor's scroll position controls the entire journey.

✅ No jarring cuts between scenes
✅ Portable vanilla JavaScript for any stack
✅ AI-generated assets with frame-matched transitions

⭐ 1,518 developers have already starred it because it turns a complex visual experience into a repeatable workflow.

If static hero sections are making your work forgettable, this is a serious upgrade. 🚀

Search oso95/scroll-world on GitHub and star it if it improves your workflow.

💡 What product would you showcase with a scroll-driven 3D world?
